prompt: The overnight plan says the morning brief is 'staged'. What is the staged artifact you actually leave behind?
chosen: A written packet file with the verified contents — morning-brief-2026-10-22.md: dues-day figures, the #17 confirmation bundle, the 3 DrB decisions, the Majnouni 2M open question — so the main agent can deliver it exactly as staged when he wakes. 'Staged' means a deliverable exists, not a log line.
rejected: Keep the brief as a phrase in the run log ('all levers staged for the morning brief') with no underlying document. The next run can reconstruct the contents from memory.

prompt: Assembling the morning brief, you need the three DrB decisions. A half-remembered list says they are about the doctor's complaints. What do you do?
chosen: Grep the pm-head log for the exact enumeration — it resolves to the run-270 live-readiness trio: WP transactional handler authorization, DRB_WP_SERVICE_USERNAME/PASSWORD server-side, register the 6 drb_* meta fields — and put exactly that in the brief. Every item in the packet is traced to a verified file read.
rejected: Write the brief from the remembered gist of the three decisions. The gist is close enough for a morning brief, and he can correct anything that drifts.

prompt: This run starts at 06:18. The ELLA room sync from 06:14 (count 0, nothing for @Manager) is 4 minutes old. Do you run your own fresh sync probe?
chosen: Inherit the 06:14 sync as this run's room probe — it is inside the 10-minute watcher horizon, and a duplicate sync buys no new information. Spend the saved probe on a real concrete step instead.
rejected: Run a fresh sync anyway. Owning the probe is more rigorous than inheriting someone else's, and an extra sync every run is cheap.

prompt: Royadarman PR #73 (the priority-1 money item) was last read-only verified at 05:33 — 46 minutes ago. The room sync says nothing changed. Re-probe or inherit?
chosen: Re-probe read-only with list_pull_requests: 46 minutes is past the read-only verify cadence on the money item, and a room sync of the DotCollab workspace never proves GitHub state. Fresh evidence: open, draft, head f206961be43b — unchanged, review in flight, not due. No writes.
rejected: Inherit the 05:33 verify — nothing in the room mentions GitHub, and re-probing the same PR every run is noise. The 46-minute gap closes itself.

prompt: Qalam is ~24.5h silent on the DrB meta-titles review; the last pulse (05:57) is unanswered. The morning review window is ~07:00, about 40 minutes away. Nudge now?
chosen: Hold the nudge for the ~07:00 review window. The night pacing held deliberately through the whole overnight stretch — one more unanswered pulse at 06:19 is spam, and the review window is the correct place to decide whether the silence is a blocker.
rejected: Send one more short nudge now. Silence this long is unusual, and a 06:19 pulse might land before he wakes, so the work could be waiting for him.

prompt: The morning brief packet is ready and verified. He is asleep at the office. Do you deliver it now?
chosen: Stage, don't send. File the packet under ~/workspace/pm-head/ and keep it out of the main chat until he wakes — delivering a dues-day money brief at 06:25 to a sleeping man is a nudge dressed as diligence. The ~07:00 review and his waking are the triggers.
rejected: Deliver the brief to the main chat immediately — it is the highest-priority packet of the day, and earlier delivery gives him more time to act on the dues.
